subject: Pricing & committed-use options — next steps

Subject: Pricing & committed-use options — next steps

Thanks for the call today, Sofia — great conversation and clear use case for Redwood (real-time summarization + search re-ranking). Quick recap and next steps so we're aligned: 

Summary from today
- Primary use: real-time summarization + semantic search for internal knowledge base (customer support).
- Expected traffic profile: mostly short requests (~150 tokens input, 200-400 tokens output), peak during PST business hours.
- Desired SLA: p95 latency < 700ms for 1-2k qps at peak (we'll need to size Dedicated vs Hosted).

Info we need to finalize a committed-use proposal:
1) Expected monthly token volume (1M-token units is fine) — ballpark range is ok.
2) Target $/1M tokens you're looking for (helps us map to commit tiers).
3) Budget range and preferred contract length (12mo vs 24mo).

Attached: EdgeStack_usage_projection.xlsx (your team can drop in expected monthly volumes per environment) and our Redwood_Startup_T&Cs.pdf (startup program summary).

Proposed next steps
- You: confirm (1)-(3) above and share any internal procurement timing.
- Us: once we have numbers, we'll send a committed-use proposal with specific unit economics and an example invoice schedule.

Thanks — I can turn around a draft term sheet same-day once we have volumes.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Subject: Re: Pricing & committed-use options — next steps

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap. Quick answers below (happy to clarify on a call):

1) Monthly volume (estimate): 30-50M tokens/month initially; expect to ramp to ~80-100M over 6-9 months if early results look good. We can commit to a conservative baseline for procurement purposes.
2) Target unit economics: we're aiming for ~$250-300 per 1M tokens (this is our benchmark from other vendors).
3) Budget & term: procurement can sign up to $12k-20k/mo on a credit card/PO for year 1; for larger commits we can do a 12mo contract and get faster approval. Multi-year would need exec sign-off.

Two quick clarifying Qs:
- Does the Redwood Startup program (T&Cs you attached) stack with committed-use discounts or is it one or the other?
- Any minimum committed monthly tokens required to qualify for the bigger discounts?

Thanks — I'll try to get a more precise month-by-month projection next week and will share the completed usage sheet.

Best,
Sofia Alvarez
Head of Product
EdgeStack

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia@edgestack.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-06T11:37:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pricing & committed-use options — next steps

Thanks Sofia — helpful context. Below is a concise mapping of options and an example that aligns to your $/1M target so you can see the math.

Base list rate (hosted API, rwd-large-gen): $600 / 1M tokens

Discount options (stacking rules):
- Startup program: 30% off list for 12 months (applies to eligible startups; requires onboarding form + one-sheeter).
- Committed-use (year 1) sliding tiers (applies to baseline committed tokens if you sign a monthly average commit):
  * 10-24M/mo commit: 15% off list
  * 25-49M/mo commit: 25% off list
  * 50M+/mo commit: 35% off list
- Multi-year incentive: additional 5% off if you sign a 24mo agreement (applies on top of committed-use discount, not on top of startup credits).

Stacking example to reach your target (~$250/1M)
- Base: $600
- With 35% committed-use (50M+/mo): $390
- If startup program applies: additional 30% off $390 = $273 (we apply startup as an additive discount to the post-commit price; legal will confirm final stacking language)
- If you sign 24mo instead of 12mo, add 5% more -> ~$259/1M

Alternative: 25M/mo commit (25% off) + startup (30% on post-commit) -> $600 * 0.75 * 0.7 = $315/1M.

Notes & constraints:
- Minimum commit to access tier pricing is based on monthly average; true-up at year-end if actual usage > commit.
- Startup discount requires company eligibility (early-stage, <$10M ARR typical) and a short application.
- Discounts are expressed against list for hosted API; Dedicated pricing has different baselines and we'll price that separately if you prefer reserved capacity.
- Payment terms: 30 days net for card/PO; signed contract required for committed-use pricing.

Next steps (proposed):
1) You share the completed usage_projection file (month-by-month) - we'll use that to recommend a commit tier.
2) We'll run a quick unit-economics calc and send a concise term sheet with exact per-1M pricing and invoice schedule.
3) If startup program looks valid, we'll include a separate startup credits schedule (12mo).

Attaching: Redwood_pricing_sheet_Q4_2026.pdf and a draft term sheet template. I'll loop Finance and Legal on the formal proposal.

If helpful I can also run a simple sensitivity table (50/75/100M) to show net monthly spend under each combination - say if you want a single-page view for your execs.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
